ops.body: Confirmed retained background sessions are skipped by rest_sessions when job.agent is cleared although job.bg still owns the session. New isolated lane perf-lane-lifetime-nov16 separates retained background identity from current-agent binding and rechecks the same session under job lock. Reproduced five unbound failures; focused 14-case regression now passes. Shipping in progress. One bounded user-authorized parallel quota worker b460f490-6fe8-4922-8467-7cace7d1cbb7 is running; daily budget policy restored to 100 immediately after its admission.
